description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to various levels of thinking, verbosity, notice, elevation, reasoning, and usage display for an AI or reasoning system. It includes normalization functions, support checks, and default resolution logic.

methods.name: isBinaryThinkingProvider
methods.description: Checks if a provider supports binary thinking levels.

methods.name: supportsBuiltInXHighThinking
methods.description: Checks if a provider supports built-in xhigh reasoning models.

methods.name: normalizeThinkLevel
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string to a ThinkLevel enum value.

methods.name: listThinkingLevels
methods.description: Returns the list of available thinking levels.

methods.name: listThinkingLevelLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for thinking levels, possibly binary based on provider.

methods.name: formatThinkingLevels
methods.description: Formats thinking level labels into a string.

methods.name: formatXHighModelHint
methods.description: Provides a hint string about provider models that support xhigh reasoning.

methods.name: resolveThinkingDefaultForModel
methods.description: Resolves default thinking level for a given model based on catalog info.

methods.name: resolveResponseUsageMode
methods.description: Resolves usage display mode with default fallback.

methods.name: normalizeFastMode
methods.description: Normalizes raw input to boolean for fast mode.
